title.rendered: What is CyberScore and How it Works: a Technical Overview

content.rendered:
ntop users as familiar with concepts such as flow risk and cyberscore. This week we have presented a conference paper [slides] at 2022 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience where we describe in detail what is cyberscore, how it works, and how we have validated it in real life. In essence this is the explanation of the idea that are powering our tools, validated by the academia and not just by our users. This is in addition to what ntop users are doing every day when using ntop tools. Below you can find the video of our presentation in case you want to learn more about it.

Enjoy !
